data: What is the value of the blue line at a |Z| of 2^13?

The blue line represents the perplexity values for different state sizes |Z|. The x-axis shows the state size in powers of two, ranging from \(2^{10}\) to \(2^{16}\). The y-axis represents the perplexity values in pPL. At a |Z| of \(2^{13}\), the blue line appears to be around 150. Therefore, the value of the blue line at a |Z| of \(2^{13}\) is approximately 150.
